title: RuWritingStyles: Russian Claude custom styles and an agentic review pipeline for scholarly writing on Sanskrit linguistics
description: RuWritingStyles is a bilingual resource for scholarly writing on Sanskrit linguistics in Russian. It combines (1) a catalogue of Russian-language Claude custom-style prompts modelled on the prose method of major philologists (Zaliznyak, Tronsky, Mel'čuk, Elizarenkova, Toporov, Lidova and others), and (2) a zero-runtime-dependency agentic review pipeline that runs a multi-style "Council" over a Markdown manuscript (segment, independent style reviews, council deliberation, revision, verification) with deterministic Sanskrit quality checks: IAST/Cyrillic transliteration consistency, GOST R 7.0.100-2018 bibliography formatting, and citation grounding. Review panels are selectable by named council (general / sanskrit / indology).
